name: ea-planet-probe
title: Earth build T14 planet probe (test only)
author: Jake Mismas
description: Test tool, never shipped. Two synthetic planets that set no property_expression_names of their own (S11's eapp-open): one surface made in on_init, which the mod under test never sees (its on_init ran first and the event never fires there), and one made at tick 1 through LuaPlanet.create_surface, which raises on_surface_created. Writes what each surface inherited from the save's default map gen settings to script-output/ea-planet-probe/.
